responsibility: Contains the machine-description patterns for VSX scalar/vector instructions and related ISA 2.06+ extensions. It defines extensive mode iterators and instruction families for VSX moves, loads/stores, permutes, scalar/vector FP arithmetic, conversions, extracts/inserts, splat-immediate support, Power9/Power10 vector operations, and builtin-oriented patterns, forming the main RTL instruction-selection layer for VSX-capable rs6000 targets.
